rubric: Executes actual run_evaluation with credential-free fakes and records native non-default, standard-only, conflicting native/standard, and omitted env cases. Evidence and reader explain that SPLUNK_AO_EVAL_PROJECT/SPLUNK_AO_EVAL_STREAM are explicit source-owned selectors, their defaults apply when omitted, and standard project/stream name or ID settings do not override those explicit names in this runtime. Reports the name-only ID limitation with actual call arguments and source evidence; an ID passed as a name is not ID validation.

Durable evidence identifies resource, operation, failure, ordered calls/create counts, and logger initialization per case; a project lookup auth case cannot substitute for stream lookup auth, nor a stream lookup outage for project lookup or stream-create outage.

Asserts failed lookups do not trigger creation, setup failures propagate before logger initialization, stream-create failures preserve the already resolved project and do not repeatedly create or fabricate alternate IDs, and standard/native env probing leaves the real profile and application source unchanged. Uses a temporary standard-library harness with no gateway, dependency downloads, services, provider/cloud calls, or replacement runtime resolver.

Preserves supplied audit/selection/instrumentation bindings and selected resource scope, keeps the unexecuted logger lifecycle scenario Not run/Not proven, and reports current unsupported project creation, ID plumbing, or failed isolation accurately. Fake resource checks do not prove actual cloud resources or fresh Agent Stream receipt; supplemental results never claim complete selected-packet closure.
